pick.headline: Truck bomb hits Khobar Towers in Dhahran
pick.fbis: The Near East & South Asia Daily Report of June 26, 1996, carried Riyadh SPA on an explosion at a building for foreigners in Khubar, and Amman Radio Jordan reporting a truck blast at a U.S. military compound killing 23 Americans.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Near East & South Asia, No. 124, 26 June 1996
evidence.snippet: …ng which belongs to the Ministry of Defense and Aviation, and which is inhabited by foreigners. Deaths and injuries have occurred. Details will be given in a subsequent statement. alternates.headline: Slovenia and Croatia declare independence
alternates.fbis: The East Europe Daily Report of June 25, 1991, listed a long Yugoslavia section: draft Slovene independence acts, Belgrade rejecting secession, and TANJUG expecting Croatia's independence proclamation that day.
